name: Neptune Beach Ball
summary:
Wade through waves of sea critters in this fast-paced, heart-pumping VR racket game. 

Alternate forehand and backhand strokes to build your multiplier and charge your special. Use the trigger to discharge your special and dispatch hard-to-reach critters. 

Complete 5 waves to reach a challenge stage where you increase your remaining time. 
**Compete on the online leaderboard and fight for the top spot!**

Choose between two game modes:
# Chains
Critters melt as your ball slices through them like a hot knif
